title: Underwriting Guide: Recent At-Fault Physical Damage Losses of a Driver Added to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
A driver added to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy may bring a recent at-fault loss. The loss load percentage of the driver addition charge follows the physical damage losses of the last six months at which the added driver was found at fault. These are read from the claim files of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage: the fault determinations finding the insured at fault with that driver named, and the claim payments issued on the claim.

## Rule

| Added driver's at-fault physical damage losses | Loss load percentage |
|---|---|
| Found at fault at such a loss in the last six months, and the payments on its claim reach the package's at-fault surcharge minimum paid | The package's at-fault accident surcharge percentage |
| Found at fault at such a loss in the last six months, and its claim has no payment yet | Half (0.5) of that percentage |
| Otherwise | Nil |

The six months run back from the day the charge is worked out, by the date of the fault determination. The payments read are those on the claim of the latest fault determination finding the added driver at fault.

## Figures by package

| Package | At-fault surcharge minimum paid, USD | At-fault accident surcharge percentage (paid loss) | Half of it (unpaid loss) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | 1000 | 40 | 20 |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | 1000 | 35 | 17.5 |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | 1000 | 30 | 15 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | 1000 | 30 | 15 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 1000 | 25 | 12.5 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 1000 | 20 | 10 |

## Truth table (hypothetical, Cardinal Auto Standard)

| At-fault finding in the last six months | Payments on its claim | Loss load percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 1000.00 or more | 30 |
| Yes | 999.99 | Nil (paid, but below the minimum) |
| Yes | None yet | 15 |
| No | any | Nil |
